routes.description: Session-validity probe for nginx auth_request (empty body, 200 or 401)
Revoke current session and clear cookie
Change password (revokes all sessions and API tokens)
Current account info (unauthenticated: 401 with bootstrap status)

methods.name: admin_account_list

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

include_deleted.description: Include soft-deleted (tombstoned) accounts in the listing. Default false (active only). Used by the admin UI to surface accounts for reactivation via `account_undelete`.

methods.description: List all accounts with their actors, role_grants, and pending offers. Admin-only.

methods.name: account_delete

account_id.description: Account to soft-delete. Omit for self-delete; another account requires admin.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

methods.description: Soft-delete an account (reversible tombstone): blocks auth, revokes sessions/tokens, soft-deletes its actor(s). Self-service for own account; admin required to delete another.

methods.name: account_purge

confirm.description: Must be `true` — fail-loud guard against an accidental irreversible purge.

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

methods.description: Hard-purge an account (irreversible cascading delete). Keeper-only + explicit confirm. Audit ids survive; identity snapshotted in metadata.

methods.name: account_undelete

acting.description: Actor on the authenticated account that this request acts as. Omit on single-actor accounts; required on multi-actor.

methods.description: Reactivate a soft-deleted account (clears the deleted_at tombstone on the account + its actors). Admin-only. Does not restore revoked sessions/tokens — principals re-auth fresh.

methods.description: Revoke all API tokens for an account. Admin-only.

since_seq.description: Gap-fill from this seq forward. Used for SSE reconnection.
